title: Dougal Shaw (Senior Correspondent, Business Leader · creator of BBC CEO Secrets) pulls the sharpest line out of the podcast: 'Who would you rather die than betray?'
summary: Shaw is a senior correspondent at Business Leader and created the BBC's CEO Secrets series. He cut a clip from the Business Leader podcast around a single question Eric puts to founders, and published it alongside his write-up of Eric's impact on entrepreneurship.
blockquote:
"Who would you rather die than betray?" Strong words from Eric Ries, author of The Lean Start Up, on our Business Leader podcast.

I think this clip really conveys some of the moral urgency behind his new book, Incorruptible. Ries is angry at the way the financial system corrupts companies as they scale. A company's original moral purpose is stripped away in the name of shareholder primacy. And this isn't even in anyone's true long-term interest.

source_urls.label: Shaw announcing the print issue carrying the Eric Ries profile interview, alongside PizzaExpress's Paula MacKenzie and Sharmadean Reid MBE (2026-10-30)
